interpretation.checklist: Descriptive item counts, not a combined score or certification. Partial never counts as met. N/A and invalid/unavailable items are excluded only from the explicitly comparable applicable denominator. Not-checked items remain in that denominator and are shown separately.
interpretation.missing: Missing assessments and future runs are missing observations, never zero scores. Supplementary judgments cannot replace assigned primaries or duplicates.
interpretation.publication: Reader links use named branches, verified against advertised remote heads at export. Exact commits and source hashes retain snapshot identity. Branches may later advance. A null public_url means publication of that raw source is not established by this export; result links are independent from assessment publication.
interpretation.replay: Assessor-infrastructure failures are unavailable, not worker failures. Same-host replay does not establish cross-host portability.
interpretation.retrieval: Coordinator preservation verifies exact stopped-worker bytes; it is not worker delivery credit or successful scientific execution.
interpretation.scientific_adequacy: Judge support for the scientific analysis is separate from support for the hypothesis. Infrastructure uncertainty flags preserve the raw scientific classification without regrading it.
